description: Delete the entire old mode system (modes.ts, ModeManager.ts) and replace it with the new TaloxSettings/TaloxConfig interfaces per the v2 spec. This phase must leave zero references to the old mode system.
acceptance_criteria: src/types/modes.ts is deleted (file no longer exists)
src/core/controller/ModeManager.ts is deleted (file no longer exists)

src/types/settings.ts exists with TaloxSettings interface and DEFAULT_SETTINGS (mouseSpeed: 0.7, typingDelayMin: 100, typingDelayMax: 300, typoProbability: 0.03, fidgetEnabled: true, humanStealth: 1.0, stealthLevel: 'high', adaptiveStealthEnabled: true, automaticThinkingEnabled: true, perceptionDepth: 'full', headed: false, autoHeadedEscalation: true, verbosity: 0, humanTakeoverEnabled: false, humanTakeoverTimeoutMs: 120000)
src/types/config.ts exists with TaloxConfig interface (profile, observe, settings, humanTakeover fields)
src/types/index.ts exports only new types, no mode exports

title: Phase 3: Rewrite TaloxController — remove modes, add verbosity + takeover state machine
description: Rewrite TaloxController to use TaloxSettings instead of TaloxMode. Add new runtime-controllable methods: setVerbosity, getDebugSnapshot, setHeaded, requestHumanTakeover, resumeAgent. Implement the takeover state machine: AGENT_RUNNING → WAITING_FOR_HUMAN → AGENT_RUNNING.
acceptance_criteria: Constructor merges DEFAULT_SETTINGS + user config, no mode system reference
setMode(), getMode(), override(), all Agent-First methods are removed
setVerbosity(level: 0|1|2|3): void method exists and changes event emission behavior
getDebugSnapshot(): Promise<DebugSnapshot> returns current AX-tree, recent bugs, console errors, network failures, last adaptation, interaction history
setHeaded(headed: boolean): Promise<void> forces browser headed/headless at runtime
requestHumanTakeover(reason?: string): Promise<void> freezes agent, triggers overlay change
resumeAgent(): void returns control to agent
onTakeover() / onAgentResumed() event hooks are implemented
Takeover state machine correctly transitions: AGENT_RUNNING → WAITING_FOR_HUMAN → AGENT_RUNNING
Auto-resume timer fires after humanTakeoverTimeoutMs ms; skips if timeoutMs is 0
npm run typecheck passes with zero errors

title: Phase 3b: Auto Headed/Headless Escalation via AdaptationEngine strategies
description: Add auto-escalation strategies to AdaptationEngine: when a headless blocker is detected, auto-relaunch headed. When resolved, de-escalate back to headless. Session state must survive browser relaunches.
acceptance_criteria: autoHeadedEscalation: true is set in DEFAULT_SETTINGS
escalate_to_headed strategy exists in AdaptationEngine: triggers on blocker detected, saves URL + cookies, relaunches headed, restores state
de_escalate_to_headless strategy exists: when blocker resolved, saves state, relaunches headless, continues
headedEscalation event emitted with reason string when escalation fires
headlessRestored event emitted when de-escalation completes
Session state (cookies, localStorage, URL, scroll position) survives relaunch via ProfileVault + SessionManager
If observe: true, bypass escalation entirely, always headed
Grep for 'escalate_to_headed' returns results in src/strategies.ts or AdaptationEngine

title: Phase 4: Human Takeover Overlay UI — rebuild TakeoverBridge correctly (no fake cursor)
description: Rebuild TakeoverBridge from scratch using correct Playwright APIs. Inject overlay via page.addInitScript() (NOT page.evaluate()). No fake cursor. Overlay has exactly the glow frame and Take Over button. Must persist across all navigations.
acceptance_criteria: TakeoverBridge uses page.addInitScript() for overlay injection — NOT page.evaluate()
page.exposeFunction() used for __talox_requestTakeover and __talox_resumeAgent bindings
Overlay contains exactly TWO elements: #__talox-overlay (glow frame) and #__talox-takeover-btn (button)
No fake cursor element injected (no #__talox-fake-cursor)
Agent running state: cyan glow box-shadow (rgba(0,212,255,0.6)), button shows '⏸ Take Over'
Waiting for human state: no glow, button shows '▶ Resume Agent' (or with countdown timer)
Overlay injected only when humanTakeoverEnabled: true AND headed: true
Headless mode: overlay never injected
bridge.reinitialize(newPage) re-runs addInitScript + exposeFunction when page is replaced
Grep for 'page.evaluate' inside TakeoverBridge.ts returns zero results

title: Phase 5: Always-On Capability Modules — remove all mode gates
description: Ensure all capability engines run unconditionally. Remove any mode-gating logic from AdaptationEngine, BotDetector, ActionExecutor (HumanMouse), RulesEngine, and PageStateCollector.
acceptance_criteria: AdaptationEngine.ts has no mode gate — always armed
BotDetector.ts has no mode gate — always scanning
ActionExecutor.ts always uses HumanMouse for all mouse interactions (no bypass path except humanStealth: 0)
RulesEngine.ts always runs bug detection; verbosity 0 = collect silently, verbosity 1+ = emit events live
PageStateCollector.ts always collects full AX-tree + DOM + console + network (no shallow path)
Grep for 'isSpeedMode' returns zero results in src/
Grep for 'shouldEmitBugDetected' returns zero results in src/
